description:
Reid eTrail 3 | Electric mountain bike
More torque. More travel. More trail capability.
The Reid eTrail 3 is an electric mountain bike designed for challenging off-road terrain and demanding trail rides. Its alloy frame features internal cable routing and an integrated 522Wh battery for a clean, streamlined finish. The long, low and slack geometry provides a confident riding position suited to technical trails and more aggressive off-road riding.
Power comes from an Ananda 250W, 36V mid-drive motor delivering 110Nm of torque for responsive assistance on steep climbs and varied terrain. The integrated 36V 14.5Ah battery provides 522Wh of capacity for extended rides, while the Ananda D18 Bluetooth display delivers clear ride data and smartphone app compatibility.
An SR Suntour suspension fork with 130mm of travel helps absorb impacts on rough ground, roots and rocky trails. The Shimano 10-speed drivetrain combines a 10-speed shifter and Shadow Plus rear derailleur with an Ananda 170mm 34T narrow-wide chainset and a Shimano 11–48T cassette. This wide gear range supports precise shifting and flexibility across steep ascents and changing gradients.
Tektro hydraulic disc brakes with 180mm rotors provide reliable braking control on varied terrain. The 29-inch WTB Trail Boss 29 x 2.4-inch tyres deliver grip and traction on challenging trails, while 740mm alloy riser handlebars and a short 50mm stem support responsive handling. An MTB saddle and ergonomic rubber grips complete the setup for off-road comfort.
The Reid eTrail 3 is ideal for:

Technical trail riding – Long, low and slack geometry for demanding off-road terrain

Steep climbs – Ananda mid-drive motor delivering 110Nm of torque

Rough terrain – SR Suntour fork with 130mm of suspension travel

Extended adventures – Integrated 522Wh battery for longer rides

Precise shifting – Shimano 10-speed drivetrain with Shadow Plus rear derailleur

Wide gear range – Shimano 11–48T cassette for varied gradients

Trail traction – WTB Trail Boss 29 x 2.4-inch tyres for grip on challenging surfaces

Controlled braking – Tektro hydraulic disc brakes with 180mm rotors

Responsive handling – 740mm riser handlebars and a short 50mm stem

Please make sure to familiarise yourself with eBike safety information before charging or using your new Reid. You can view and download user manuals and safety instructions here.
